rules.description: Clears administrator and user BIOS passwords by erasing the dirty NVRAM variable bank (offset 0x007BC000 - 0x007C5FFF) to 0xFF.
rules.action: Locate the primary active NVRAM bank containing user-modified AMITSESetup, and fill with 0xFF. BIOS automatically recovers default (password-free) setup from the default store upon next boot.

rules.description: Preserves Serial Number, Motherboard UUID, MAC Address and Windows Product Key located in the DMI area.
rules.action: Ensure the DMI block remains untouched during password clearing or donor injection.
